neighbours.label: a physical size or dimension word (thickness, size, wide, short, smaller) describing an object
fire: The steel plates come in a thickness of three to five millimeters.
These bolts are slightly shorter than the ones in the original kit.
The tires on the new model are much wider than before.
The crystals grow to a size of about two centimeters.
Our new tent is narrower but taller than the old one.
The cable has a diameter of just one tenth of an inch.
Each tile is smaller than a postage stamp and very thin.
The table legs are short, so it sits low to the floor.
quiet: The steel plates come from a mill in the north of the country.
These bolts are slightly cheaper than the ones in the original kit.
The tires on the new model are much quieter than before.
The crystals grow in caves deep under the mountain.
Our new tent is greener but cheaper than the old one.
The cable has a warranty of just one year from purchase.
Each tile is painted by hand and very colorful.
The table legs are oak, so it looks rustic and warm.

notes: Card: thickness, smaller, size, wide, short; no single token. The - pole is evaluative attributes (performance, taste), so + may be the physical-magnitude side. Probe was weak (~0.15 of max).
